events.strDescriptionEN:
The tournament was completely dominated by American golfer Andrew Novak, who claimed his second career PGA Tour title and his first ever individual solo victory. Novak put on a record-breaking performance, carding a blistering 61 on Friday and a 62 on Saturday. He cruised to a five-stroke victory on Sunday, finishing at an extraordinary 25-under-par (259) to establish a new tournament scoring record.
With this victory, Novak secured $1.08 million from the $6 million total purse and earned 500 vital FedExCup points, positioning himself securely for the 2027 signature events.
